-- V2: optional link expiry.
-- Additive and nullable: existing rows stay valid and the previous application version keeps working.
-- Rollback: redeploy the previous version (it ignores this column); remove the column in a later release.
ALTER TABLE short_url ADD COLUMN expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE;
